gate_changes_reviewed: Control R17 explicitly corrected R16 and adopted applicability-aware HOLD semantics already used by Evidence Analyst R21: hold_class/hold_reason required iff classification=HOLD; terminal_state/queue_state required for all material objects.

The prior cross-role HOLD applicability disagreement is therefore resolved prospectively; hold_multidimensional_model, hold_field_applicability_mask, and completeness applicability semantics move from CLARIFY to KEEP.

Fresh eligibility-history Discovery was prospectively MECHANISM with eligible=true in principle and NOT_READY before outcome, then accepted an exact ordinary per-edge eligibility-trace reduction and REJECT with no rescue.
Independent Audit R3 preserves C19-v4 immutable PASS but finds programme-level mechanistic novelty reducible by authoritative C19-R2 fixed seven-state FSA evidence.

Future external-validation superiority/novelty claims should prospectively use competent nondegenerate references and relevant simple reduction baselines under matched privilege; when observations share an atomic/source unit, inference should be clustered at that unit.
No universal numeric readiness/support threshold and no retroactive rescore/relabel of consumed evidence is recommended.
false_positive_risks: An external-validation effect can be overinterpreted as mechanism/novelty support when the registered reference is degenerate or zero-performing and simpler state-machine reductions are not prospectively included.
Pair-IID resampling can overstate certainty when multiple pair observations share an atomic/source unit; use source-cluster inference prospectively when such dependence exists.
A future SYSTEM-over-comparable-MECHANISM allocation could still be justified post hoc unless system_priority_exception is persisted before allocation; first live use remains unobserved.
A 3/3 recent MECHANISM window could become a prestige/target ratio if operators forget that one-in-three is a minimum only.
false_negative_risks: Do not universalize FSA/state-tracker comparators or cluster bootstrap to unrelated bounded Discovery questions; apply the tightening to external-validation superiority/novelty claims with the relevant dependency structure.
Do not require a positive signal or prior comparator victory merely to become preformal_eligible or READY.
Do not suppress useful SYSTEM architecture/testbed/reproducibility work simply because recent MECHANISM supply is 3/3.
Do not treat the C19-v4 programme-level REDUCIBLE interpretation as retroactive invalidation of its exact immutable registered PASS.
Avoid serial near-neighbor responsibility/credit microprobes once they stop separating distinct mechanisms; choose by marginal information gain or use no-target/no-op semantics.

The 3/3 window is therefore not evidence of quota manufacturing, but the recent responsibility/credit clustering merits an opportunity-cost watch.
